name: driftle
description: Driftle - a multiplayer word game where the answer moves. Semantic search, Wordle-style spelling unlocks, and a drift mechanic that re-scores the whole board.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run check:lexicon && npm run test:sim
